values.description: future
Excellent - A trustworthy source backed by strong analysis or direct measurements.
Good - Trustworthy source. Partly based on assumptions or imperfect analysis.
Acceptable - Acceptable source. May rely on many assumptions, shallow analysis, or rough measurement.
Lacking - Questionable or unverified source. Poorly measured or weak analysis.
Unacceptable - No or untrustworthy source. Unsupported assumption.
Excellent - From this region and at the correct aggregation level or a directly-applicable generic value.
Good - From an analogous region or the modelled region at incorrect aggregation level.
Acceptable - From a relevant but non-analogous region or highly aggregated.
Lacking - From a non-analogous region with limited relevance or a generic global value.
Unacceptable - From a region that is highly dissimilar to the modelled region, or from an unknown region.
Excellent - Excellent representation of the system, as good or better than other models.
Good - Well modelled, in line with what others are doing.
Acceptable - Room for improved representation but works for now.
Lacking - Poorly represented, overly simplified.
Unacceptable - Placeholder or dummy representation. Essentially not represented.
Excellent - For the modelled technology as represented. Directly applicable.
Good - For the same general technology but not perfectly representative.
Acceptable - For an analogous technology. Possibly a subset or general class. Roughly applicable.
Lacking - Loosely representative. A niche subset or overbroad general class of the technology.
Unacceptable - For a dissimilar or unknown technology. Unknown or poor applicability.
Excellent - From or directly applicable to the modelled time.
Good - From a different but similar time or only slightly out of date. Still highly relevant.
Acceptable - From a somewhat similar time or several years out of date but still relevant.
Lacking - From a time with different conditions or significantly out of date. Questionable relevance.
Unacceptable - From an irrelevant time or badly out of date.
